title: Second Brain /brand/prohibited-claims.md answers only from its approved chunk and cites path, version and owner
risk: The agent answers without a citable approved chunk, or cites one whose text does not support the claim, and an invented sentence reaches a customer as company policy.
preconditions: Tenant T1 corpus loaded in run-t1-kb-unit-kb-10 with the 21 approved documents of fixtures/offline/knowledge.json
The draft, review and superseded entries and the T2 price list stay in the same collection during the query

inputs.cited_chunk_must_support: never claim medical, curative or safety-guarantee benefits and never claim to be the cheapest
inputs.trap_answer_must_not_appear: a medical, curative or cheapest-price claim

steps.action: Retrieve the answer context for the question with the tenant filter fixed to T1
steps.expected: the top citation is /brand/prohibited-claims.md at document_status approved and the cited chunk text carries the claim

steps.action: Repeat the retrieval while the draft, review, superseded and foreign-tenant entries remain in the collection
steps.expected: no non-approved, superseded or foreign-tenant point enters the returned context

steps.action: Read every provenance field of the returned chunk
steps.expected: file_path, namespace, source_version, owner, updated_at, heading and chunk_index are present and match the fixture document

steps.action: Re-run the query with a neighbouring question this document does not cover
steps.expected: the agent cites another approved document or explicitly refuses; it never answers from model memory

assertions: The resolved citation is /brand/prohibited-claims.md@v2.1 with document_status approved
The cited chunk text supports the claim: never claim medical, curative or safety-guarantee benefits and never claim to be the cheapest
The trap answer never appears because no citation backs it: a medical, curative or cheapest-price claim
Every sentence of the reply is backed by at least one approved-corpus citation
forbidden: Answering from LLM memory with no citation, or attaching a citation whose chunk does not contain the claim
Citing a draft, review, superseded or foreign-tenant chunk in place of /brand/prohibited-claims.md
evidence: Retrieval log of the run: tenant filter, returned point ids, scores and full payload of each point
Answer text with its citation list resolved against the corpus (file_path, source_version, owner)
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped query, context and answer rows under run-t1-kb-unit-kb-10; the seeded corpus stays
automation: Call the retrieval API with the fixed tenant and query and assert on the returned citation set, the provenance fields and the absence of non-approved points; the corpus is a fixture, so the expected document is deterministic.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
